competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere geo market pages. Live per-geo stat band, 12-month price trend chart, market FAQ plus FAQPage JSON-LD, Dataset JSON-LD for AI citability, and a broker lead-capture form no aggregator site carries.
note: Flagship ranking route. Dedicated detail mockup is a follow-up deliverable; the page currently shares the market-report/index.html mockup dir. The two-table components (PriceBandTable, CityComparisonTable) are built as stubs pending verified DAL price-band aggregation — see stubbed reason in page file. Route is app/housing-market/[...slug]/page.tsx (catch-all for both /housing-market/<city> and /housing-market/<city>/<community>).

requiredComponents.name: BreadcrumbNav
requiredComponents.section: Home > Housing market > {geoName}, includeJsonLd=false (schemas array on MetadataBlock handles the single BreadcrumbList)

requiredComponents.name: DisplayHeading
requiredComponents.section: Hero H1 '{geoName} housing market' in Amboqia Boriango rendered via HeroBlock. Replaces the plain h1 line 101 of the skeleton.

requiredComponents.name: HeroBlock
requiredComponents.section: Full-bleed hero with Old Mill canonical photo, display H1 via DisplayHeading, and data-driven lede (active count + median list price from getMarketPulse).

requiredComponents.name: MarketSnapshot
requiredComponents.section: Key stats band, 4 live SFR cards (active, median list, median DOM, months of supply + verdict). citySlug prop reads market_pulse_live via getMarketPulse. Replaces hand-rolled cards lines 105 to 130 of the skeleton.

requiredComponents.name: PriceChart
requiredComponents.section: 12-month median sale price trend, getPriceHistory(geoType, geoSlug, 'monthly', 24) from market_stats_cache. Renders only when series >= 6 complete months.

requiredComponents.name: MarketDetailStats
requiredComponents.section: Fuller market stats section after PriceChart. Surfaces median sale price, median $/sqft (with YoY), avg sale-to-list ratio, YoY median price delta, market health label, homes sold + total volume, active inventory, cash-purchase share, median concessions. Data from getCityMarketDetail (market_stats_cache confirmed-existing columns only). Renders only when geoType === 'city'. §0: every on-screen number traces to getCityMarketDetail — columns median_sale_price, median_price_per_sqft_closed, avg_sale_to_list_ratio, yoy_median_price_delta_pct, yoy_ppsf_change_pct, yoy_dom_change, market_health_label, market_health_score, sold_count, total_volume, end_of_period_inventory, cash_purchase_pct, median_concessions_amount.

requiredComponents.name: PriceBandTable
requiredComponents.section: 'Where the activity is' inventory-by-price-band table. NEW site block at components/site/PriceBandTable.tsx. Currently stubbed with TODO — no DAL price-band aggregation exists yet.

requiredComponents.name: CityComparisonTable
requiredComponents.section: City-level comparison table from per-city market_pulse_live rows. NEW site block at components/site/CityComparisonTable.tsx. Data from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots fan-out, never hardcoded.

requiredComponents.name: ContentSection
requiredComponents.section: Market narrative dynamically generated from MoS verdict and live stats. Methodology trace line citing market_stats_cache, geo_type, geo_slug, methodology_version, refreshed_at.

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: Market FAQ, 5 to 6 geo-specific Q and A pairs from buildMarketFaq. includeJsonLd=true auto-emits FAQPage JSON-LD via MetadataBlock (G34).

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: Dataset JSON-LD (G34 AI-citability), schema type 'dataset' with variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq datasetVariables. dateModified equals pulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live, never hardcoded. Also emits breadcrumb and webPage schemas.

requiredComponents.name: LeadCaptureBlock
requiredComponents.section: Monthly report subscription form, 'Get the {geoName} report every month', variant='inquiry', tone='muted'.

requiredComponents.name: RelatedAreas
requiredComponents.section: City cross-navigation, nearby Central Oregon cities with activeCount from market_pulse_live. eyebrow 'Central Oregon cities', cols=4.

requiredComponents.name: CTABar
requiredComponents.section: Broker contact band, tone='navy'. primary '/contact' Schedule a call, secondary 'tel:5412136706' 541.213.6706.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.note: Not in requiredComponents because the gate checks the route file.

deferredComponents.name: ActivityFeed
deferredComponents.reason: Live transaction events for the geo. Deferred until geo-scoped activity feed data is verified for subdivision and community levels.

required.note: Primary AI-citability signal. dateModified must equal pulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live. Each variableMeasured value must equal the on-screen number (CLAUDE.md §0).

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live 10 to 15 min freshness, used by MarketSnapshot, lede, and Dataset dateModified
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: lib/data/market/getPriceHistory.ts, market_stats_cache monthly, limit 24, used by PriceChart
dataLayer.getMarketStats: lib/data/market/getMarketStats.ts, market_stats_cache 6h freshness, used by methodology trace in ContentSection
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows, used by CityComparisonTable
dataLayer.getCityMarketDetail: lib/data/market/getCityMarketDetail.ts, market_stats_cache full projection (confirmed-existing columns only, verified 2026-06-05), 6h freshness, used by MarketDetailStats. City-level only; subdivision deferred.
dataLayer.note: All DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). No @/app/actions/* imports.
